admission.justification: Realized across roleChatDispatch.ts, RoleChats.tsx, and roleChatOptionsLoader.ts, and proved by RoleChats.dispatch.test.tsx and RoleExecutionStatus.test.tsx.

applicability: Automatic dashboard role launcher options refresh immediately after dispatchRoleAction.
conditions: Dispatch or offline recovery obtained a settled RoleExecutionReceipt matching the exact requestScope and requestId.
The follow-up options load is automatic (neither explicit Retry nor Refresh) for the same document scope.
exclusions: Unresolved (202/unknown), absent, or mismatched receipts and explicit Refresh or Retry still fetch /api/role-launch/result.
statement: The options refresh after a settled dispatch preserves and reuses the result from the exact request.
title: Post-dispatch refresh preserves and reuses a settled exact-request result
